item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi rgyud las rgyud 'debs byin rlabs myur 'jug
item.coloph: ces pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur 'jug 'di/ bla ma'i bka' dang grogs kyis nan bskul bzhin/ gsang sems rgyud 'dzin tha shal bstan 'brug pas/ bgyis pa'i dge des 'gro kun rdzogs byang smon//
